name: sharp-pen
description: Focused proofreading that never rewrites you. Hand it a draft and get back an interactive two-pane page: your text on the left, every suggestion on the right, each one clickable. Accept changes one at a time, or choose between alternative phrasings from a dropdown. Two passes — spelling and grammar, then sentence construction. It corrects form, never substance: it won't change what a sentence claims, strip a hedge, or make casual prose corporate.
